# DH-ADOM

## A Governed Operating Model for AI-Native Software Engineering

**DH-ADOM — DevHeal Hierarchical Agent Development & Orchestration Model**

AI-native software development needs more than an LLM in the IDE. When agents can plan, modify code, use tools, and delegate work, the engineering organization itself becomes executable.

DH-ADOM defines that organization.

### The model

```text
Engineering Constitution
        ↓
AI-SDLC
        ↓
ADLC
        ↓
Root Agent
        ↓
Feature / Domain Agents
        ↓
Bounded Specialist Agents
        ↓
Implementation + Validation
        ↓
Evidence + Handoff
        ↓
Root Review + Integration
```

### Publication package

- White Paper
- Technical Specification
- Reference Templates
- Reference Implementation
- Conformance / Validation Suite
- Benchmarks & Experiments
- Architecture Diagrams
- Research / Publications
- Version History

### Key idea

> The Root Agent orchestrates. The Feature Agent owns. The Specialist Agent assists. AI-SDLC governs development. ADLC governs agents. Evidence proves completion.
